<notes> Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 4 sq.; Y. ib. IV, 41

<italic>gentile woman</italic>. Y. Yeb. II, 4
<sup>a</sup> top ואין בנך מן הג' וכ' thy son from a gentile is not called thy son but her son (Bab. ib. 23
<sup>a</sup> נכרית); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. גּוֹיוֹת</plural-form>. Y. ib. IV, 6
<sup>a</sup> bot. [Y. Gitt. I, 43
<sup>b</sup> top, a. e. גויים לוקין, v. גַּיּוּס.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00364">
<head-word>גְּוִיל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>

<notes /></sense>

<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a roll of parchment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>b</sup> bot. must rend his garments הג' בפני עצמו וכ' once for the burnt parchment and a second times for the writing; Bab. ib. 26
<sup>a</sup> אחת על הג' Ms. M.—Ib. (ref. to Jer. XXXVI, 27) המגילה זה הג' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) 
<italic>m’gillah</italic> refers to the writing paper, 
<italic>hadd’barim</italic> to the writing.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּוִילִין</plural-form>. Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> I see ג' נשרפין וכ' En Yakob (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50, ed. incorr. גליון) the parchment burned but the letters soar upward.—Esp. 
<italic>g’vil</italic>, a certain kind of parchment, v. דּוּכְסוּסְטוֹס. Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 7 (if one sold) ספר של צבאים … של ג' a book for deer-skin and it is found to be 
<italic>g’vil</italic>. Mass. Sof’rim I, 4. Sabb. 79
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00537">
<head-word>גָּזַז</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to cut, shear</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 11 (play on גינת אגוז, Cant. V, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> הגינה שאני גוזז אותה וכ' the garden which I trim at all times.</definition>
<notes> Ib. when they sin מיד אני גוֹזְזָם I cut (punish) them at once; Yalk. Cant. 992.—Ḥull. 138
<sup>a</sup> הא צאנו לָגוֹז but when he hires his (the gentile’s) sheep for shearing (Rashi לִגְזוֹז). Ib. לגזוז; a. e.—Part. pass. גָּזוּז (v. גִּזָּה) 
<italic>covered with fleece</italic>. Koh. R. to I, 9 a time will come when the wolf להיות ג' וכ' shall have a fleece of fine wool.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגְזַז</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut, trimmed, shorn.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ukts. I, 4 את שדרכם לִיגָּזֵז וכ' those plants which usually are cut but which have been taken out with their roots. Pesik. R. l. c.; Yalk. l. c. כל דבר שהוא נ' מיד וכ' whatever (plant) is cut (trimmed) soon drives new shoots and grows better. Cant. R. to VI, 11 מה האגוזה נִגְזֶזֶת וכ' as the nuttree is trimmed and shoots anew. Ib. כצפרנים הללו שנִּגְזָזִין וכ' as the nails are cut and grow again, כך כל מה שישראל נגזזין מעמלן וכ' so the more Israel is shorn of his worldly toil and given up to the toils of the study of the Law.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> (prov.) when the camel asked for horns, אודנין דהוו ליה גָּזְיִין מיניה they cut off the ears he had. Ib. 96
<sup>a</sup> אִיגְזְיָיךְ אנא I myself will cut thy hair. Succ. 37
<sup>b</sup> אתי למִגְזַיֵּיה he may be induced to cut it (Ms. M. למיכל … למיתלש). Gitt. 3
<sup>a</sup> אתי למיגזייה he may cut it short, i.e. say only a portion of a lengthy legal formula, v. גּוּז. Y. ib. V, 47
<sup>b</sup> top ומה דאת גָּזֵי גְזֵי and what crop thou mayest cut, cut, i.e. enjoy the crop as my tenant; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass, go out of one’s way</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> לגְזוּיֵי לה Rashi, v. גְּזַז. Ib. וגזי לה (Ms. M. גייז ליה, v. גּוּז) he went out of the demon’s way.—Targ. Jer. VIII, 6 דגָזְיָא Ar. s. v. גז 4 (ed. גזר, corr. גזי) which passes swiftly (h. text שוטף).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<italic>to deal out, dispense, repay</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Zakhor p. 24
<sup>b</sup> [read:] למִיגְזֵי לטבא טיבותיה ולמ' לבישא בישותיה (v. Bub. note 68 sq.) to repay the good man his goodness &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 6 למזגיה (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. ib.; Treat. Sof’rim XIV, 7 למזגא, למגוא (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ps. 719.—Y. Taan. IV, 69

<sup>c</sup> top וגזה ליה.</notes></sense></senses>
